mentions.name: Paperboy
mentions.description: Self-hostable service that generates a personalized daily research digest from recent arXiv papers (and optionally a few other sources). It fetches new papers, scores them against a research profile, produces concise summaries plus a 'why this matters' rationale, and outputs an email/newsletter-like HTML digest. Includes a small API for generating a digest, checking status, and previewing the render.
mentions.problem: Keyword alerts and generic newsletters were either too noisy or missed papers actually relevant to the user's current work.
